title: Camera Prices Could Rise in 2027. Buy on a Plan, Not on a Panic.
excerpt: Canon told investors it no longer expects memory prices to fall in 2027, and will raise camera prices if costs stay high. That is a reason to make your next purchase decision now, not to rush one.

title: A Client Had to Tell This Photographer She Was Charging Too Little
excerpt: Laura BC charged 250 pounds for a music shoot in London. The artist told her another photographer earned 3,000 pounds for comparable work, and that her work was better. Underpricing is usually a missing calculation, not a lack of confidence.

title: Your Phone Can Now Coach Your Framing. It Still Cannot Teach You to See.
excerpt: Google's Camera Coach, now refined on the Pixel 11 Pro, suggests reframes and details as you shoot. It is a useful drill for beginners, and a poor substitute for learning light, intent, and why a frame works.
